scope: Build candidate complete-source data only from the original training-only inventory; no training or score selection.
selection: All2632 rows whose full original WAV container plus full RIR960 fits all five current150-frame windows. Do not use exact-zero support to recover more rows. Group exact original WAV hashes into2594 canonical sources, assert same engine/label/length, keep every alias metadata row and original label. Canonical is lexicographically first original path; order by canonical path.
rendering: Copy existing GPU prepare_british_features.py three fixed conditions: source float64 PCM16/32768, original speed/container, RMS .08, 32000 leading and16000 trailing samples. Variant0 dry/no noise; variant1 dry/white noise25dB; variant2 full fftconvolve RIR[1@0,.25@160,-.12@480,.06@960],white noise15dB. Per canonical path and variant SHA-prefix64 RNG seed from path+':{variant}:phone-v1'. Final gain limits peak to.95. No waveform crop or phonetic endpoint; retain full convolution length.
features: One new MicroFrontend per full rendered stream, exact PCM rounding/clipping once before features(). Keep real frontend history and all raw uint16 arrays. e=ceil((32000+signal_samples)/160)-1. Main is raw[e-150:e], sequence is raw[e-150:e+12]; retain fixed phase and all sample bounds. Output x[N,150,40],sequence_x[N,162,40],y[N]. No artificial feature padding/reset or temporal jitter.
limits: This is candidate input data, not a training/sampling protocol, a model, a detector result or a replacement for v39.
Source labels are preserved intended texts; no phonetic truth or pronunciation audit is claimed. Exact alias grouping does not make TTS conditions/blends independent speakers.
Conservative sample bounds and crop/history validation do not establish model receptive-field, streaming-score or cross-host numerical equivalence.
Canonical WAVs are reverified at construction; all alias source bytes were verified by the preceding frozen inventory. No claim of opening each alias again.
No validation/new/final WAVs, detector scoring, training, TTS generation, audio playback/recording, board, firmware, service or production-device operation.
